notes: Same shape-sweep convention as softmax.json (cols swept across representative transformer hidden/feature-dimension widths at a fixed, representative rows=4096) -- see src/kernels/norm/README.md for what each rung changes. Every swept cols value here is a multiple of 4 (V3's cols%4==0 requirement, common/launch_validate.hpp::validate_cols_multiple_of_4) so all three variants are directly comparable at every point. gamma (per-column learned scale) is random in [0.5,1.5); eps=1e-5 (bench_cli.hpp default).
